pages.title: A Very Serious Circle
pages.text: The correctly drawn shape provides real protection from bears.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The native interaction must actually produce a circle block, not merely a sand click. The Dictionary describes protection from Sea Bears; humorous provocations are not compulsory objectives. Drawing is available on April 1 or while the native April Fools mode superSecretSettings is enabled. On other

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: dates without that mode, the interaction is unavailable.
